_how_to_use: Rotating on-screen text for @tikshop.uk style slideshows. For each slideshow pick one line per slot, never reusing a line already used in this batch (or in the last 2 days, per the usage log) until every line in that slot has been used. {sale} = BLACK FRIDAY (Nov), CHRISTMAS (Dec), JANUARY SALE (Jan), otherwise 'sale'. {product} = a short, natural product name (2-4 words, e.g. 'Henry vacuum', 'ghd hot brush'). {price} = the live sale price from the listing. You may also write a NEW line in exactly the same voice instead of a bank line (about 1 in 3 times) so posts never look copy-pasted. Keep censoring with * (f*cked, TF) and keep 1-3 emojis from the style list.
